decisions.reason: Free no-signup web search bridge for models without native web access is a repeatable research outcome (inputs: query + scope; outputs: cited passages; evidence: fetched URLs + dates). Highest daily-use value in the snapshot and the K4 lead candidate.
Composable cross-session memory needs a reviewed storage/privacy contract (what persists, where, who can read it) before any capability shape. Memory architecture review comes first.
decisions.revisit: a reviewed memory storage/privacy contract plus retention and scoping rules

decisions.reason: Generate/edit/compare images with prompts and gallery is a repeatable media-creation outcome (inputs: prompt + constraints; outputs: image bytes + provenance; evidence: seed/model record, held-out prompt checks). Provider keys stay operator-supplied prerequisites, never bundled.
Phone-as-remote for a computer-run web UI is a transport/host feature, not a task outcome. GPL-2.0 repo license additionally bars copying code into this MIT tree — link out only.
prerequisites: user installs the host plugin in DSH's own plugin flow

decisions.reason: Credential-handling API-key proxy: community tool traffic (including keys) through a third-party endpoint, with NOASSERTION repo license. No credential-boundary contract and no reuse rights — cannot be listed as anything but link-out.
decisions.revisit: an asserted reuse license plus a reviewed credential-boundary contract

decisions.reason: IM-bot bridging over QR/robot credentials (Feishu, WeChat, DingTalk, Slack, Telegram, Discord, WhatsApp) is a credential-gated host integration, not a repeatable task outcome. User-installed host plugin only.
prerequisites: user supplies bot credentials in DSH's own plugin flow
